== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor's crown serves as a primary symbol of imperial [[Authority|authority]] and rule. It is distinguished from the imitation silver headwear used by a [[body double]] during a fraudulent coronation ceremony. Beyond its status as a ceremonial object, the crown possesses significant power, having been utilized by the Emperor to manipulate the minds of numerous [[Consultants]] on [[Gray Island]]. [[The crown]] is a potent symbol of the [[throne]], and there are concerns that if a [[Great Elder]] were to seize control of the Emperor, they could effectively possess the crown and the world alongside him.}}
